name: R1 EDU U1
summary: Unitree R1 EDU U1: entry EDU configuration (reichelt 'EDU-Standardausführung', 40 TOPS per reichelt) without dexterous hands. R1 EDU platform per Unitree: about 1.23 m; 6 DoF per leg, 5 per arm, 2 waist and 2 head, with a total of 26-40 DoF depending on configuration; binocular camera, 4-mic array and speaker, about 1 h battery life, secondary development supported, 12-month warranty. Total DoF for this configuration is unresolved (reichelt 24 vs Unitree's 26-40 EDU range; see specs_note). Sources: unitree.com/R1 and reichelt.com, agent-retrieved 2026-09-11.
specs_note: RETRIEVAL: AGENT_ASSISTED_RESEARCH (docs/26) — retrieved 2026-09-11 by Claude Opus 5 (curl + WebFetch) in a session initiated by Robert Konecny for European Catalogue Gap Batch 01B, under research work order 'OWNER WORK ORDER — BATCH 01B COMMERCIAL RESEARCH' (2026-09-11; docs/26 §2.1). Not a MANUAL_BOOTSTRAP reading. Not human-verified. height_cm 123.0 from Unitree's R1 table ('Height, Width and Thickness（Stand） 1230x357x190mm', R1 EDU column). payload_kg UNKNOWN (owner decision, 2026-09-11): Unitree's row reads 'Maximum Torque of Arm Joint【1】 About 2kg' — labelled as torque but expressed in kg, with footnote 【1】 on 'the maximum load of the arm' — so the source wording is internally inconsistent and no payload is recorded. runtime_minutes 60 from 'Battery Life About 1h'. has_vision: 'Binocular camera'. has_language_ui: the R1 page states 'Integrated with a Large Multimodal Model for voice and images' plus a 4-mic array and speaker — a series-level marketing claim, and footnote [7] warns some sample functions are still being developed, so MEDIUM. has_sdk / developer_edition: 'Secondary Development【2】 YES' for R1 EDU only. has_api: 'Fully open control interfaces for joints and sensors' (R1 page) and reichelt's 'high- and low-level programming'. simulation_support: R1 page 'support for mainstream simulation platforms'; reichelt 'support for simulations (e.g., Isaac SIM)'. Compute (no catalogue field): Unitree lists the High-Power Computing Module for R1 EDU as 'Multiple brands and models available such as Orin(40-100TOPS)'. Edition identity: the U1–U6 codes are distributor configuration codes (reichelt 'Man. part no.'); Unitree's own page names only 'R1 EDU' (26-40 DoF, 'Dexterous Hand: Optional') and publishes no U-code table, so model_code stays NULL. ros_support, autonomy, walk_speed, battery_wh, reach and arm span are not stated by any fresh primary source and stay UNKNOWN. weight_kg 29.0 from Unitree's R1 EDU column ('About 29kg'); reichelt lists 25 kg ('Weight: 25000 g') and a separate 'Weight (manufacturer specs) 40 kg' (plausibly shipping weight) — preserved as a conflict, manufacturer value used. CONFLICT (DoF) — degrees_of_freedom left UNKNOWN (owner decision, 2026-09-11): reichelt's U1 page lists 'DOF: 24' and its U2 page frames U2 as '+2 DOF in the head (26 total)', i.e. a 24-DoF U1 without head joints. Unitree's own table gives R1 EDU 'Head Degrees of Freedom 2' and a total range of '26-40'. The manufacturer range does not identify U1 specifically enough to resolve this configuration-level conflict, so both observations are preserved here and no total is recorded. reichelt also lists '40 Tops AI computing power' for U1 (no catalogue field).
